title: Ended agent sessions should show their outcome (Merged, Review approved, Stopped by close-out) instead of a bare "Session ended"
body:
## Problem

Every agent whose terminal is gone shows "Session ended", whether it finished its job or died. Most ended sessions finished normally: reviewers exit after their verdict, close-out stops an issue's agents, and a work agent ends after its PR merges. The operator cannot tell a normal finish from a crash at a glance, so every "Session ended" row looks like something to investigate (operator report, 2026-09-28).

## Where the label appears (origin/main)

- `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/issue-view/AgentStepRow.tsx` (~line 418, "Session ended cleanly and is no longer live.")
- `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/drawer/DrawerAgentSession.tsx` (~lines 113, 244)
- `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/CommandDeck/SessionView/SessionPanel.tsx` (~line 518)
- `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/CommandDeck/ConversationTerminal.tsx` (~line 96)
- `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/TerminalSessionWrapper.tsx` (~line 42)

## Wanted

An ended session shows its **outcome** instead of a bare "Session ended", for example:

- **Merged**: the work agent's PR merged.
- **Review approved** / **Changes requested**: a reviewer exited after its verdict.
- **Tests passed** / **Tests failed**: a test specialist exited after its result.
- **Plan finalized**: a planning agent finished.
- **Stopped by close-out** / **Stopped by operator**: stopped deliberately.
- **Ended unexpectedly**: none of the above. Only this case keeps an attention color.

Derive the outcome; do not store a new status. Overdeck stores no status it can derive: the sources are the per-issue pipeline journal (`src/lib/cloister/pipeline-journal.ts`), the PR on the forge, the agent's role, and the supervisor's `stopped` lifecycle event (`src/lib/agents/liveness.ts` is the one liveness module). Where they disagree, the PR wins.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Every surface listed above shows the derived outcome label for an ended session, with the plain "Session ended" text used only when no outcome can be derived.
2. Only "Ended unexpectedly" uses an attention color; normal outcomes follow the style guide's quiet treatment (the `pan-style-guide` skill).
3. The outcome is derived at read time from existing facts; no new persisted status field.
4. Unit tests cover each outcome mapping, including the fallback.
5. Docs: update `docs/ISSUE-VIEW.md` (and any user-facing page that describes agent states) with the outcome labels.
